text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the "Legendary Secret Hot 
Spring," the hot spring town flourished 
even more. The new hot spring facility is 
running smoothly, too.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"We're completely fully booked too♪ It 
seems the therapeutic benefits of hot 
springs are steadily spreading among the 
public."
—It was around that time.

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, I finally made it, whoa...! These 
crutches are really in the way...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Are you staying the night? Um... allow me 
to take your hand.

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry. I managed to get this far 
on my own, after all. Apparently, it's 
better if I try to move around by myself 
as much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see. Initiating Operation: 'Luggage 
Transport.'
choice_data_list: I'll show you to the reception desk!
I'll show you to the reception desk!

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you. Um, who might you all be...?

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But our goal here is strictly to 
refresh ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Um... I truly feel for you..."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"A fracture... How could this... 
............"

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... I'm in the Classic Class 
right now, but I ended up overdoing my 
training, you see...

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I'm naturally suited for 
sprints, I just really wanted to challenge 
the Triple Crown races. For that 
once-in-a-lifetime glory..."

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And this is how it ended. Guess it really 
was reckless after all...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I don't think so.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. This emotion... Inferred status: 
'Empathy.'"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I, too, have pushed my body beyond its 
limits in an effort to exceed my own 
performance boundaries. Therefore...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I understand your wavering feelings. 
However, I believe you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the risk isn't zero. However, 
we can minimize it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Based on my own experience and the health 
theory I learned here, I can say for 
certain.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If you want to make it come true, then 
moving forward isn't a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
—Precisely. What matters is how you go 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Proprietress... I have a question. Could 
you tell me the details of her 
recuperation plan?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Heh, curious, are you? Perfect timing. I 
was just thinking having someone run 
alongside me would be good for my mindset.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Does that mean...! You want me to help 
with her rehabilitation?"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, normally I have Yunohana do it, but 
business has been booming, so we've been 
swamped.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"The plan was originally for me to teach 
you what real R&R is all about, but we 
never got the chance to sit down and do 
it. How about it?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please let me do it. According to my 
calculations... it is possible. I wish to 
verify that...!

And so, once the injured girl's period of 
rest came to an end... the landlady's 
rehab guidance began!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Come now, dear patient. Open your eyes, 
please. Starting today, we begin your 
rehabilitation...!

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"A public pool... Ah, so like... light 
exercise to start without putting a strain 
on the legs, right...?"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Indeed it is. Please, go right 
ahead and begin.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Operation: "Pool Training" Commencing now!

And as the two began to swim... The 
landlady kept a sharp eye on the injured 
girl.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ho, looks like your cardiovascular stamina 
hasn't dropped as much as I expected. 
Let's start slow, pacing ourselves to a 
human's speed.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer. It's 320 meters at a 
pace of 1 meter per second. Don't time it!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
I'll go grab a heart rate monitor. Listen 
here, over the next few weeks, we're gonna 
make sure you can swim with a lower heart 
rate than today!

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh!? Doing this over and over is pretty 
rough...? I'm kinda... out of breath...! 
*gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Underwater, the pressure on your 
chest increases. Since you can't train 
your legs as much, we'll train your lungs 
instead!
choice_data_list:
(This was supposed to be light exercise... 
it was not!)

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh... There's a walking course inside the 
footbath...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... On the long course in the back, 
you can run on an underwater treadmill to 
soothe your ankles with chilled onsen 
water.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
This seems suitable as a step before 
trotting on land. Given her ligament 
injury, applying a moderate load would be 
ideal.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Recent studies have shown that doing so 
helps tendon fibers recover with a more 
regular alignment than just resting 
completely, and—

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Exercising after so long felt great... 
Still, to think this waterfall bath is 
also part of my rehab...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
By warming the entire body and stimulating 
the skin, peripheral blood circulation 
improves.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
According to research, it has been shown 
to promote the healing of muscle soreness 
and musculoskeletal disorders. And...

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Heh~... Whoa... it's so warm...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It also has a relaxing effect. ...Visually 
confirming target's condition. Status: 
'Warm and Cozy'.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Next, to relieve the target's stress, 
executing Operation "Chit-Chat."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Being a listener... is my strong suit. In 
the past, Rice-san once praised me, 
saying, 'You're such a good listener.'

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what's that supposed to mean~? Well, 
we're both active racing Umamusume, so...? 
Guess I'll have you listen to a bunch of 
my thoughts then.

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhh! My back...! Are massages supposed 
to hurt this muuuuch!?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hohohohoho, dear guest, it seems your 
stomach is feeling a bit weak as well. I 
shall inform the chef.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
I've been doing this since my trainer 
days. I just wanted to ease the exhaustion 
of the girls under my wing, you see.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you know that muscle fibers grow 
stronger through a cycle of breaking down 
and repairing, right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Muscle is what breaks through the 
wall of distance aptitudes.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Slow-twitch and fast-twitch muscles are 
largely determined by genetics, but they 
can still be trained.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
If you speed up recovery with massages, 
you can cycle between training and resting 
that much faster.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Updating data... Could you perhaps teach 
me that massage technique?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Well then, that concludes the laser 
treatment and ultrasound. Everything is 
progressing quite smoothly! Is there 
anything concerning you?

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. I'll keep working hard at this 
pace. So I can run like I used to 
again...!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
My previous running style... you say? 
Strictly speaking, it is slightly 
different.

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
The injured area will never completely 
return to how it was. Even if the bone 
itself regains its strength.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why our goal is the 
recovery of motor function. To bring it as 
close as possible to how it was before the 
injury."

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"That is what matters. ...Isn't that 
right, young doctor?"

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Just as you say. Let's not give up and do 
our best."

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—I see... I guess I really can't go back 
to who I used to be. Even after trying 
this hard...

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry. Saying such gloomy 
things...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural... Losing everything 
you've built up so far would break 
anyone...

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yeah......

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However......

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, I can still run...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "So please... don't despair."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Just being able to run again is, in 
itself, a miracle."

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...! I know the truth, deep down...

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Everyone did everything they could for 
me... and I tried my best, too... and 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Once I'm back on the turf, I have to run 
like my life depends on it, or it means 
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... I will run. For the sake of 
all the girls whose dreams couldn't come 
true...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes... Please, run...!

Her rehabilitation continued slowly after 
that. Eventually, she departed from the 
inn with a strong, confident smile—
